Our stay at Spiti Valley Hotel was truly unforgettable. From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed with warmth and genuine hospitality that made us feel more like guests at a home than customers at a hotel.

The location of the hotel is absolutely stunning. The views are breathtaking — snow-covered mountains, open valley landscapes, and the peaceful vibe of Spiti all around you. Waking up to that scenery every morning is an experience in itself.

The service was exceptional throughout our stay. The staff was attentive, polite, and always ready to help with a smile. The food deserves a special mention — fresh, delicious, and served with so much care. After long days of exploring Spiti, coming back to such comforting meals felt perfect.

One of the most beautiful parts of our stay was spending time with the owner, Ajay ji. His house is within the hotel premises, and he personally ensures that every guest feels comfortable. We used to sit and hang out with him, listening to stories and sharing conversations. He is an amazing personality — humble, warm, and deeply connected to the place. That personal touch made our experience even more special.

Overall, Spiti Valley Hotel is not just about great views, great service, and great food — it’s about heartfelt hospitality and creating memories. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Spiti Valley. Looking forward to coming back again soon!
